questions.answer:
import re
from collections import Counter
def tokens(text):
    return re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', text.lower())
def cosine(a, b):
    ca, cb = Counter(tokens(a)), Counter(tokens(b))
    dot = sum(v * cb.get(k, 0) for k, v in ca.items())
    na = sum(v * v for v in ca.values()) ** 0.5
    nb = sum(v * v for v in cb.values()) ** 0.5
    return 0.0 if not na or not nb else dot / (na * nb)
print(tokens('AI, agents!'))
print(round(cosine('ai agent', 'ai agents'), 3), round(cosine('ai agent', 'cats'), 3))
# ['ai', 'agents']
# 0.5 0.0

questions.explanation: Bag order bhool jaata hai.

questions.question: Cosine similarity TF-IDF vectors par dot product se better kyun?
questions.answer: Cosine length-normalized hai, isliye lambe documents chhote se unfairly score nahi le jaate. Raw dot product length se inflate hota hai.
questions.explanation: Length normalization.

questions.question: Attention me softmax ke bina kya problem hoga?
questions.answer: Weights negative/unbounded ho sakte hain aur sum 1 na ho, isliye weighted combination meaningless ho jaata hai. Softmax scores ko non-negative aur normalized weights me badalta hai.
questions.explanation: Softmax weights ko valid banata hai.

questions.question: Attention ki complexity sequence length ke saath kaise badhti hai?
questions.answer: O(n²) (har token har token ko dekhta hai) — isliye lamba context cost/memory explode karta hai. Isliye sparse/linear attention aur chunking jaise optimizations bane.
questions.explanation: Quadratic = lamba context mehnga.

questions.question: Multi-head attention ka ek head hataya to kya asar hoga?
questions.answer: Model ki capacity kam hogi — different heads alag relations capture karte hain (syntax, coreference, positional). Ek head hatana mostly performance gira deta hai (par theoretical guarantee nahi ki har head unique kaam karta hai).
questions.explanation: Heads different patterns pakadte hain.

questions.question: Positional encoding ke bina transformer ko kya problem aayegi?
questions.answer: Self-attention permutation-invariant hai, isliye order ka pata nahi chalega ('dog bites man' = 'man bites dog'). Positional encodings sequence order ki information add karte hain.
questions.explanation: Order ki information explicit add karni padti hai.

questions.question: Transfer learning me embedding layer freeze karo to kya bachta hai aur kya milta hai?
questions.answer: Bachta: bahut kam parameters train hote hain (fast, less data, overfit kam). Milta: domain-specific tokens ka adjustment nahi hota, isliye specialised vocabulary (medical/legal) par performance limited reh jaati hai.
questions.explanation: Parameter/frozen trade-off.

questions.question: Word error rate aur F1 score kab-kab use karte ho?
questions.answer: WER speech recognition/translation jaisi sequence generation me (edit distance based), F1 classification/NER me per-label. Metric task ke output type se choose hota hai.
questions.explanation: Generation vs classification metric.

questions.question: Fine-tuning ke baad validation accuracy girayi, train accuracy badhi — kya karoge?
questions.answer: Overfitting hai: learning rate chhota karo, epochs kam/early stopping, layer freezing, weight decay ya dropout badhao, aur chhota dataset ho to few-shot/prompt-based approach par jao.
questions.explanation: Classic overfit signature.

questions.question: NER me subword tokenization ke saath label alignment ka issue kya hai?
questions.answer: Ek word kai subword tokens me toot jaata hai, isliye label ko sirf first subword par lagana padta hai (BIO me B-) aur baaki ko ignore (-100) karna padta hai — warna loss galat jagah compute hota hai.
questions.explanation: First subword par label, baaki ignore.

questions.question: Beam search width 1 aur width 5 me kya farq hoga?
questions.answer: Width 1 = greedy (fast, sometimes suboptimal), width 5 = 5 hypotheses explore (better quality par 5x compute/latency). Real-time systems me width aksar 1-3 rakhi jaati hai.
questions.explanation: Quality vs compute.

questions.question: Text classification me TF-IDF+LogisticRegression vs transformer embeddings — chhote data par kaun better?
questions.answer: Chhote data (<5-10k examples) par TF-IDF + linear model often comparable ya better hota hai (fast, interpretable, no GPU), aur transformer tab jeetta hai jab data/domain zyada ho ya complex semantics chahiye.
questions.explanation: Data size decision driver hai.

questions.question: Embedding similarity 0.98 aur 0.71 ka practical matlab kya hai?
questions.answer: 0.98 almost duplicate/paraphrase, 0.71 related topic par different statement. Absolute thresholds model-specific hote hain, isliye apne corpus ke distribution se cutoff set karo.
questions.explanation: Threshold data-specific hai.

questions.question: Stopword removal sentiment analysis me nuksan kab karta hai?
questions.answer: Negation words ('not', 'no', 'never') stopwords me hote hain, isliye removal sentiment ulta kar deta hai. Isliye sentiment me negation words rakho ya negation handling (prefix tagging) karo.
questions.explanation: Negation stopword nahi hota.

questions.question: Lemmatization aur stemming me kaunsa kab choose karte ho?
questions.answer: Stemming sasta par crude ('studies' → 'studi'), lemmatization linguistically sahi ('studies' → 'study') par slow aur POS information maangta hai. Search/retrieval me stemming chal jaata hai, display/IE me lemmatization.
questions.explanation: Speed vs correctness.

questions.question: NLP pipeline me text normalization ki ordering kya honi chahiye?
questions.answer: Decode/unicode normalize → case fold (agar case matter nahi) → strip/whitespace fix → tokenize → (stem/lemma) → stopword/negation handling. Order badalne se results badalte hain, isliye ek hi function me step-by-step likho.
questions.explanation: Ek hi normalization function rakho.

questions.question: Language detection galat ho to downstream par kya hoga?
questions.answer: Galat tokenizer/stopword list lag jaayega, isliye embeddings bekaar aayenge aur classification random jaisa lagega. Fix: detection confidence check karke low-confidence ko 'unknown' bucket me daalo aur report karo.
questions.explanation: Confidence threshold rakho.

questions.question: Class imbalance NER me kaise dikhta hai aur kya karoge?
questions.answer: O label bahut dominate karta hai (>90%), isliye model sab O predict kar dega. Fix: class weights/loss masking, entity-level F1 se evaluate karo (token accuracy se nahi), aur hard negatives mining.
questions.explanation: Token accuracy jhooti tasalli deti hai.

questions.question: Classifier har input ko same class predict kar raha hai. Pehla diagnostic kya?
questions.answer: Label distribution check karo (imbalance?), feature variance (sab zeros/constant?), aur learning rate/epochs. Aksar label column galat index se aa raha hota hai ya text normalization ne sab kuch same bana diya.
questions.explanation: Labels aur features print karo pehle.

questions.question: TF-IDF vectorizer train aur inference par alag vocabulary bana raha hai. Fix?
questions.answer: Vectorizer ko train par fit karo aur usi fitted object ko save/deploy karo (pipeline me), inference par sirf transform. Separate fit ki wajah se feature index mismatch hota hai aur predictions bakwaas aati hain.
questions.explanation: Ek hi fitted vectorizer share karo.

questions.question: NER model ke predictions me labels off-by-one dikh rahe hain (entity ek token aage). Wajah?
questions.answer: Tokenization aur label alignment mismatch — special tokens (CLS/SEP) ya subword offsets ka adjustment missing hai. Fix: offset mapping se alignment karo aur ek test case se verify karo.
questions.explanation: Alignment hi asli bug hai.

questions.question: Text preprocessing se emoji aur non-ASCII hatane par user complaints aayi. Fix?
questions.answer: Regex ne data destroy kiya. Fix: sirf control characters hatao, emoji ko preserve karo (ya explicit placeholder banao), aur Unicode normalize (NFKC) use karo; preprocessing changes ke saath metric regression test chalao.
questions.explanation: Data delete karne se pehle measure karo.

questions.question: Model validation par bahut accha, production me kharab — NLP me sabse common wajah?
questions.answer: Train/serve preprocessing mismatch (lowercasing, unicode, tokenizer version) ya vocabulary OOV. Fix: preprocessing ek shared artifact me, serving par schema+preprocessing assertions, aur production samples ka shadow eval.
questions.explanation: Consistency hi asli issue hai.

questions.question: Padding na karne se batch build nahi ho raha. Fix kaise karte ho?
questions.answer: Batch ko max length tak pad karo (ya dynamic padding), attention_mask do taaki padding ignore ho, aur sorting by length se padding waste kam karo. Bahut lamba sequence truncate karo with a documented max length.
questions.explanation: Pad + mask + truncate.

questions.question: Training loss NaN ho gaya fine-tuning me. Kya check karoge?
questions.answer: Learning rate (bahut bada), gradient clipping, mixed precision overflow, aur label index range (cross-entropy me out-of-range labels). Pehle chhote subset par LR 1e-5 se test karo.
questions.explanation: LR aur labels pehle.

questions.question: Inference memory OOM ho raha hai bade batch par. Practical mitigation?
questions.answer: Batch size kam karo, gradient/activation checkpointing (training), mixed precision, sequence length limit (truncation), aur model quantization/distillation. Throughput vs memory measure karke trade karo.
questions.explanation: Batch aur length control karo.

questions.question: Two models (v1/v2) ki metric same dikh rahi hai par predictions different hain. Kya check karoge?
questions.answer: Metric dataset (subset/split difference), prediction threshold (probabilities same hain ya nahi), aur preprocessing version. Predicted labels same bhi ho sakte hain jab probabilities different hon — isliye distributions compare karo.
questions.explanation: Labels ke bajaye distributions compare karo.

questions.question: Text me trailing whitespace aur case variants se duplicate classes ban gayi. Fix?
questions.answer: Normalize before labelling: strip, case fold, unicode NFKC, aur label taxonomy validate (allowed set). Duplicate labels ko ek group me merge karo aur count report karo.
questions.explanation: Normalize + taxonomy lock.

questions.question: Sentiment model 'not bad' ko negative predict kar raha hai. Root cause aur practical fix?
questions.answer: Negation handling missing (stopword removal ne 'not' hata diya ya bag-of-words ne order kho diya). Fix: negation prefixing ('not_bad' token), n-grams, ya contextual model; aur negation test cases eval set me add karo.
questions.explanation: Negation test cases add karo.

questions.question: Transformer fine-tuning bahut slow hai chhote dataset par. Kya optimize karoge?
questions.answer: Freeze base layers aur sirf classifier/akhir kuch layers train karo, chhota model (distilled), sequence length truncate, batch size badhao with gradient accumulation, aur mixed precision. Baseline ke saath time measure karo.
questions.explanation: Freeze + smaller model + fp16.

questions.question: NLP service ke p95 latency spikes dikh rahe hain — debugging plan?
questions.answer: Token length distribution dekho (lamba input = zyada compute), batching behavior (batch size 1 par path slow?), model warm-up (pehla call heavy), aur GC/memory pressure. Max length aur sequence bucketing se spikes kam hote hain.
questions.explanation: Input length ke saath latency correlate karo.

questions.question: Evaluation me entity F1 high hai par users unhappy — kya check karoge?
questions.answer: Evaluation set distribution (production se match karta hai?), rare entity types (macro F1 chhupi hui ho sakti hai), partial-match scoring, aur normalization differences (case/punctuation). Per-type breakdown nikaalo.
questions.explanation: Per-type breakdown chahiye.

questions.question: Tokenizer version upgrade ke baad predictions badal gaye. Rollout plan?
questions.answer: Tokenizer ko model artifact ke saath pin karo (same version), upgrade ke saath re-tokenization aur offline eval chalao, phir shadow → canary rollout. Isse silent mismatch nahi hota.
questions.explanation: Tokenizer model ke saath versioned.

questions.question: Language model prompt me 'ignore past' type text aaya aur output weird ho gaya. Pehle kya karoge?
questions.answer: Input sanitization/truncation check karo, prompt template me user text ko clearly delimit karo, aur output validation lagao. Long unbroken text ko chunk karo (context overflow silently truncate hota hai).
questions.explanation: Delimit + truncate + validate.

questions.question: Real-world: support tickets ko 20 categories me classify karna hai (labels thode noisy hain).
questions.answer: Pehle label taxonomy clean karo (duplicates/overlaps merge), chhote labelled set par TF-IDF + linear model baseline banao, per-class metrics dekho, aur confuse wale pairs ke liye rules/threshold tune karo. Model se pehle labels theek karna sabse bada fayda deta hai.
questions.explanation: Labels pehle 20% improvement dete hain.

questions.question: Real-world: CV se skills extract karni hain (free text, mixed formats).
questions.answer: Two-stage: (1) gazetteer + fuzzy matching se known skills (fast, high precision), (2) ML/NER layer un matched spans ke liye. Output me normalized skill id + evidence span do, aur precision/recall per skill report karo.
questions.explanation: Rules + model ka hybrid.

questions.question: Real-world: review text ka sentiment + aspect (delivery/food/price) nikalna hai.
questions.answer: Aspect-based pipeline: sentence split, aspect detection (keyword list se start karo), phir per-aspect sentiment model chalao, aur overall score ko aspects ke saath dikhao. Per-aspect F1 evaluate karo, overall accuracy se nahi.
questions.explanation: Aspect-wise evaluation zaroori.

questions.question: Real-world: duplicate support tickets detect karo (semantic similarity).
questions.answer: Text normalize → TF-IDF baseline (quick win) → embedding similarity (~0.85+ threshold) → kalman/most-recent-cluster. Threshold ko labelled pairs par tune karo aur precision-first rakho (galat merge costly hai).
questions.explanation: Threshold ko precision-first tune karo.

questions.question: Real-world: multilingual corpus me sentiment model deploy karna hai (English-trained).
questions.answer: Sirf translate-then-classify ya multilingual embeddings use karo, par language-wise evaluation zaroori hai — English par trained model Hindi/Hinglish par randomly behave kar sakta hai. Per-language metrics + fallback (low-confidence → human) rakho.
questions.explanation: Per-language eval ke bina deploy nahi.

questions.question: Real-world: long documents ko classify karna hai (context se bade).
questions.answer: Two-stage: pehle relevant sections retrieve/rank karo (TF-IDF ya embedding), phir un sections ko aggregate (mean/max pooling ya hierarchical model) karke classify karo. Poora document truncate karna signal kho deta hai.
questions.explanation: Retrieve → segment → aggregate.

questions.question: Real-world: keyword extraction (per document top terms) chahiye.
questions.answer: TF-IDF se document-specific terms, ya TextRank-style graph ranking, ya (better) embedding + MMR se diverse keywords. Stopwords/negation handling pehle, aur output me score do taaki user threshold lagaye.
questions.explanation: TF-IDF + MMR diversity.

questions.question: Real-world: chatbot intents classify karna hai jahan naye intents aate rehte hain.
questions.answer: Unknown/other class + confidence threshold rakho (open-set), embeddings + nearest-intent routing se naye intents ko data milte hi add karo, aur misclassified queries ko weekly review queue me bhejo. Static closed-set model jaldi stale ho jaata hai.
questions.explanation: Open-set + feedback loop.

questions.question: Real-world: PII redaction NLP pipeline me karna hai (Indian formats).
questions.answer: Multi-pattern detection: regex (email, phone with +91, Aadhaar/PAN patterns validate with checksum) + NER layer for names/addresses. Redact se pehle log counts, aur false negative cases ko test suite me add karo — over-redaction vs leak ka trade decide karo.
questions.explanation: Regex + NER + checksum + tests.

questions.question: Real-world: ASR transcript ko searchable banana hai (fuzzy).
questions.answer: Transcript ko normalize (case/punctuation), phonetic key (Soundex/Metaphone-style) plus n-grams index banao, aur query par dono (lexical + phonetic) match karke rank karo. WER ke hisaab se threshold adjust karo.
questions.explanation: Phonetic + lexical hybrid.

questions.question: Real-world: named entity linking (entity ko knowledge base se jodna) kaise karoge?
questions.answer: Candidate generation (aliases/dictionary + embedding search), phir disambiguation (context overlap + prior popularity), aur tie par 'unknown' return karo. Precision-first rakho aur per-entity-type accuracy report karo.
questions.explanation: Candidates → disambiguate → report.

questions.question: Real-world: text summarization ka evaluation kaise karoge (ROUGE ke alawa)?
questions.answer: ROUGE/BERTScore ko reference-based signal maano, par faithfulness (summary ke claims source me hain) aur coverage (key facts included) bhi measure karo — human spot-check 30 samples ke saath. Extractive summary se baseline banao.
questions.explanation: Faithfulness + coverage + human spot-check.

questions.question: Real-world: small labelled data (500 examples) par best NLP approach kya hai?
questions.answer: Pretrained embeddings + simple classifier (logreg/SVM) ya transformer ka classifier head with freezing; data augmentation (paraphrase, back-translation), active learning se next samples chuno, aur strict CV (mean±std) se compare karo.
questions.explanation: Pretrained + light head + active learning.

questions.question: Real-world: NLP model ka regression suite kaise banaoge?
questions.answer: Frozen eval set (per class/per language), deterministic inference (fixed seed, greedy), aur assertion thresholds (macro F1 >= X, per-class recall >= Y). Har model/preprocessing change par CI me chalao aur delta report karo.
questions.explanation: Frozen set + thresholds.

questions.question: Real-world: spam/toxic content moderation me false positive control kaise karoge?
questions.answer: Two-stage: high-precision rules/model for clear cases, uncertain band ko human review queue me bhejo (auto-action nahi). Threshold ko FP cost ke saath tune karo aur appeals process measure karo.
questions.explanation: Uncertain → human, auto-action nahi.

questions.question: Real-world: multi-label classification me threshold per label kyun chahiye?
questions.answer: Har label ka base rate aur cost alag hota hai, isliye ek global threshold se rare labels miss honge aur common labels over-predict honge. Per-label threshold validation set par tune karo, micro/macro F1 dono track karo.
questions.explanation: Per-label thresholds.

questions.question: Real-world: domain shift (legal text par news-trained model) kaise handle karoge?
questions.answer: Domain-specific embeddings/pretrained model (ya continual pretraining on in-domain text), domain vocabulary augmentation, aur in-domain evaluation set first. Sirf fine-tuning ke bharose mat rakho — tokenizer bhi domain ke liye kaam nahi karta.
questions.explanation: In-domain eval + domain pretraining.

questions.question: Real-world: NLP inference cost kam karna hai 70% se zyada.
questions.answer: Cascade: sasta model/rule pehle, confident cases par hi ruk jao aur sirf uncertain ko bade model bhejo. Saath me distillation, quantization, input truncation aur batching — har step ke baad quality metric verify karo.
questions.explanation: Cascade + distill + quantize.

questions.question: Real-world: text data ka quality audit (labels + duplication + skew) kaise karoge?
questions.answer: Reports: label distribution, duplicate text rate (exact + near-dup via hashing/MinHash), length distribution, aur class-wise sample review. Skew/duplicates aksar baseline se hi zyada improvement dete hain.
questions.explanation: Audit pehle, model baad me.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhare NLP project ka baseline kya tha aur model ne kitna fayda diya?'
questions.answer: Baseline: TF-IDF + logistic regression par macro F1 0.78. Transformer fine-tuning ke baad 0.86 (mean over 5 folds, std 0.01), par latency 12ms → 90ms badhi — isliye cascade rakha (simple cases baseline par, complex model par).
questions.explanation: Baseline + delta + cost.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumne text normalization me kya-kya hataya aur why?'
questions.answer: HTML tags, control characters aur extra whitespace hataye; case fold kiya (classification ke liye); par emoji/negation preserve kiye kyunki sentiment signal the — aur ek test suite hai jo ye rules dono directions me verify karta hai.
questions.explanation: Har removal ka reason.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer poochta hai tumne annotations kaise manage kiye' — jawab?
questions.answer: Guideline doc (examples with edge cases) likha, 50 samples par ek saath label karke inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa 0.81) measure ki, disputed cases discuss karke guideline update ki, aur ek held-out gold set freeze kiya evaluation ke liye.
questions.explanation: Guideline + kappa + gold set.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Model ka bias (dialect/slang) kaise check kiya?'
questions.answer: Eval set ko dialect/slang buckets me baanta aur per-bucket metrics nikale — Hinglish par recall 12% kam nikla, isliye data collection me us bucket ko boost kiya aur per-bucket dashboards add kiye. Overall average ne problem chhupai thi.
questions.explanation: Per-bucket evaluation.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhare model ka deployment constraint kya hai aur usse kaise satisfy kiya?'
questions.answer: p95 latency < 100ms aur CPU-only. Isliye distilled model + int8 quantization + max length 128 use kiya; evaluation me F1 1.5 point gira par latency 90ms → 35ms aayi (measured p95).
questions.explanation: Constraint + measured trade.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Production me input text badalne par tumhe kaise pata chalega?'
questions.answer: Length distribution, OOV/tokenizer coverage, per-class prediction distribution aur confidence histogram monitors — plus drift alert. Ek baar upstream ne text me HTML inject kiya, tab se ye monitors live hain.
questions.explanation: Distribution monitors.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumne evaluation set ko production se representative kaise banaya?'
questions.answer: Sampling production par clustered (queries, languages, lengths), per-segment counts fix kiye, aur ek 'hard cases' bucket rakha (negations, mixed language, very short text) — random sample alone representative nahi hota.
questions.explanation: Representative sampling + hard bucket.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Agar tumhare paas 10x labelled data ho jaaye to approach kaise badloge?'
questions.answer: Chhote par TF-IDF baseline ka fayda kam hota jaata hai; 10x data par transformer fine-tuning clearly jeetta hai, threshold tuning stable hoti hai, aur rare classes ke liye evaluation reliable banti hai. Isliye plan: data badhne par model capacity badhao, par eval aur monitoring same rakho.
questions.explanation: Data scale ke saath capacity.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Text pipeline me tumne error handling kaise ki?'
questions.answer: Har stage par explicit fallback: decode errors (errors='replace' with count), empty text ko 'unknown' bucket, tokenizer failure par raw-length heuristic, aur pipeline-level counters in metrics. Silent skip nahi — sab counted.
questions.explanation: Fallback + counters.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: is problem me classical ML kaafi tha, deep learning kyun?'
questions.answer: Honest answer: shuru me classical kaafi tha (baseline 0.78) aur deep learning tab justify hua jab error analysis ne dikhaya ki errors mostly context/negation aur long-range dependence ke the — wahi transformer ka actual fayda tha, na ki 'modern is better'.
questions.explanation: Error analysis se justify karo.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhara system hate speech detect karta hai — false negatives ka kya hua?'
questions.answer: FN ko reported (recall per bucket), high-risk categories par threshold tighter rakha (recall-first), aur human review queue me uncertain band bheja. Precision-recall trade ko business ke saath document kiya, silently 'balanced' claim nahi kiya.
questions.explanation: Recall-first with documented trade.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Model update ke saath evaluation ka process kya hai?'
questions.answer: Har candidate model: frozen eval set + per-bucket metrics + latency/cost + error analysis top-50 mistakes. Sirf improvement ke saath merge hota hai, aur rollback ek config/artifact swap hai. Eval results PR me attach hote hain.
questions.explanation: Eval report PR me.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumne user feedback ko evaluation me kaise use kiya?'
questions.answer: Thumbs-down cases ka trace store kiya, weekly triage se failure buckets banaye (preprocessing, label, model), aur fix ke saath us case ko eval set me add kiya — isliye wahi galti dobara regression test me pakdi jaati hai.
questions.explanation: Feedback → eval case.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Explain a failure mode jise tum abhi tak fix nahi kar paaye.'
questions.answer: Sarcasm aur code-mixed (Hinglish + emoji) sentiment 30-40% cases me galat jaata hai kyunki training data me examples kam hain. Isliye us bucket me model ka output low-confidence mark hota hai aur human review me jaata hai — limitation declared, chhupai nahi gayi.
questions.explanation: Known limitation + mitigation.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: tokenization tumhare system me kitna important hai?'
questions.answer: Bahut — tokenizer vocabulary, subword policy aur truncation strategy directly recall/quality decide karte hain. Practically: tokenizer ko model ke saath version pin kiya, offsets se label alignment kiya, aur max length ka choice eval se justify kiya.
questions.explanation: Tokenizer decisions measurable hote hain.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhare NLP stack ka cost per 1k requests kya hai aur kya scale karega?'
questions.answer: CPU-only distilled model ~35ms/request par chalta hai, isliye 1k requests me ~35s CPU — cost measurable. Scale plan: sequence bucketing, dynamic batching, aur cascade (rules pehle) se 3-4x throughput, quality same.
questions.explanation: Cost + scaling levers.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: tumne model interpretability ke liye kya kiya?'
questions.answer: Linear baseline par coefficients (top features per class), transformer ke liye attention + token attribution sample-level, aur misclassification ke liye nearest neighbours dikhata hoon — isse debug aur trust dono better hote hain.
questions.explanation: Attribution + neighbours.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhara NLP pipeline kitna testable hai — test examples do.'
questions.answer: Pure functions: normalize(text), features(text), align(labels, offsets) — sab unit tested with edge cases (empty, emoji, long, mixed language). Model layer mocked, aur integration par ek tiny end-to-end golden file compare.
questions.explanation: Pure functions + golden test.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Agar maang ho ki model explainable aur auditable ho, tum kya badloge?'
questions.answer: Model ko simpler (logreg/GBDT with monotonic constraints) ya distilled rules + saliency reports par shift karta hoon, prediction logs ko versioned rakhta hoon with input snapshot, aur decision thresholds ko documented policy banata hoon — audit ke liye reproducibility pehli shart hai.
questions.explanation: Simplify + log + document policy.

questions.question: Embedding-based dedupe 100k docs par 40 second le raha hai (har doc har doc se compare ho raha hai). Fix?
questions.answer: O(n^2) pairwise comparison hai. Fix: embeddings batch me encode karo, ANN index (faiss/hnswlib) se top-k neighbours lo, aur MinHash/LSH se candidate pairs filter karo — 40s se ~2s, quality eval se verify.
questions.explanation: ANN + LSH, quadratic scan nahi.

questions.question: Evaluation report me ek class ka recall 0.00 dikh raha hai jabki confusion matrix me uske predictions maujood hain. Bug kya hai?
questions.answer: Label mapping mismatch (labels list alphabetical hai par predictions integer-encoded) ya zero_division default se 0 dikhta hai. Fix: labels=... explicitly pass karo aur encoder mapping verify karo.
questions.explanation: Labels ka order/mapping check karo.

questions.question: Binary text classifier ka loss 0.693 par constant atka hai. Diagnose karoge kaise?
questions.answer: 0.693 = ln(2), yani model sab kuch 0.5 predict kar raha hai: LR bahut chhota/dead, features all-zero (vectorizer fit nahi hua), ya labels constant. Steps: label distribution, feature variance, aur ek chhote subset par overfit attempt.
questions.explanation: ln(2) = 'model kuch seekha hi nahi'.

questions.question: Real-world: labelling budget seemit hai — active learning loop kaise banaoge?
questions.answer: Baseline train karo, phir sabse uncertain (probability 0.4-0.6) aur sabse diverse (embedding clusters se ek-ek) samples chuno, 200 label karao, retrain karke metric delta report karo. Per-class recall dekho aur stop rule (budget/plateau) pehle decide karo.
questions.explanation: Uncertainty + diversity sampling.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Confidence threshold kisne decide kiya aur uske badalne par kya hota hai?'
questions.answer: Threshold business cost matrix se decide hua (missed case ka cost 5x tha false alarm se) aur validation set par sweep kiya; ab config me versioned hai. Threshold badalne par precision/recall mix shift hota hai, isliye change ka bhi eval report banta hai.
questions.explanation: Threshold = policy, versioned + evaluated.

questions.question: Explain: Tokenization ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Tokenization: text ko tokens/subwords me split karna. Example: tokenizer("hello world"). Pitfall: model-specific tokenization.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: NLP model inputs banane ke liye.

questions.question: Define: Normalization ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.

questions.question: `'AI, agents!'.lower().split()` aur regex tokenizer `[a-z0-9]+` — output kya hoga?
questions.answer: `split()` → `['ai', 'agents!']` (punctuation token ke saath chipka rehta hai), regex → `['ai', 'agents']` (saaf tokens). Vocabulary aur cosine similarity regex version par hi sahi kaam karti hai — warna `agents!` aur `agents` do alag tokens ban jate hain.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Bag-of-words me `'ai agent'` vs `'ai agents'` ka cosine similarity kitna aayega?
questions.answer: 0.5 — tokens `['ai','agent']` vs `['ai','agents']`, sirf `ai` match karta hai: dot = 1 aur dono norms √2 hain → 1/2. `'cats'` ke saath 0.0 aata hai. Ye ek number hi stemming/lemmatization ki zaroorat proof karta hai.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Transformer ke outputs me labels tokens se misalign hain — pehla check kya?
questions.answer: Labels aur token list ki length match karo: tokenization ke baad `input_ids` me special tokens ([CLS]/[SEP]/padding) add hote hain, jo labels me nahi hone chahiye. Padding tokens ko loss se exclude karo (`-100` ya attention mask) warna loss aur metrics dono galat aate hain.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Kaun sa edge case text pipeline ko todta hai?
questions.answer: Khaali/whitespace-only input (vocab lookup me kuch nahi milta → empty vector ya crash) aur max-length se lamba text (silent truncation). Guard: `if not text.strip(): return []` aur explicit `truncation=True, max_length=...` — truncation ko chhupne na do.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Text cleaning kahan karo — ingestion par ya model input ke waqt?
questions.answer: Ingestion par normalize karo (lowercase, unicode normalisation, whitespace collapse) ek versioned function me, aur wahi function training aur serving dono me reuse karo; model input par sirf tokenizer-specific step. Do jagah alag cleaning = train-serve skew.

questions.question: Bada model vs fast inference — pehle kya optimize karoge?
questions.answer: Pehle latency budget aur quality bar likho, phir sasta option test karo: quantization → distillation → chhota model/caching. Bade model ka fayda eval set par measurable ho tabhi lo, warna latency aur cost dono badhte hain bina user-visible gain ke.

questions.question: LLM kya hai?
questions.answer: Large Language Model large text/data corpora se language patterns learn karta hai aur token-by-token generation ya language understanding tasks perform karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Tokenization kya hai?
questions.answer: Text ko tokens me break karna. Model raw text ke bajay token IDs process karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Embedding kya hai?
questions.answer: Token/text ko dense numeric vector me map karna, jisse semantic relationships mathematically represent kiye ja sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Transformer ki key strength kya hai?
questions.answer: Self-attention ki wajah se long-range relationships ko parallel processing ke saath model karna easy hota hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Self-attention ka intuition?
questions.answer: Current token ke liye sequence ke relevant tokens ko importance weights dekar context vector banana.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Q, K, V kya hain?
questions.answer: Query poochta hai mujhe kya relevant chahiye, Key batata hai token kis type ka context deta hai, Value actual information carry karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Positional information kyun chahiye?
questions.answer: Attention itself token order ko inherently encode nahi karta, isliye sequence position information add karni hoti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Causal language modeling kya hai?
questions.answer: Previous tokens dekhkar next token predict karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Masked language modeling kya hai?
questions.answer: Sequence me kuch tokens hide karke model ko context se unhe predict karwana.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Temperature ka role?
questions.answer: Sampling distribution ki sharpness change karta hai; lower usually more deterministic, higher more diverse.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Top-k vs top-p?
questions.answer: Top-k fixed number of likely tokens rakhta hai; top-p cumulative probability threshold ke basis par variable candidate set banata hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Context window kya hai?
questions.answer: Ek model request ke dauran available token budget jisme input/context/output constraints operate karte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Hallucination kya hai?
questions.answer: Model ka plausible-looking lekin unsupported/incorrect information generate karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Fine-tuning kab use karoge?
questions.answer: Behavior/style/task adaptation ke liye jab prompt + retrieval se repeatable quality achieve na ho aur labeled training data available ho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: LoRA kya hai?
questions.answer: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach jisme low-rank trainable updates use hote hain instead of all model parameters.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Quantization kya hai?
questions.answer: Weights/activations ko lower precision representation me convert karke memory aur compute reduce karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Distillation kya hai?
questions.answer: Large teacher model ke behavior ko smaller student model me transfer karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Model selection kaise karoge?
questions.answer: Quality, latency, context, tool support, cost, privacy, reliability aur workload fit ke against benchmark karunga.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: LLM evaluation kyun hard hai?
questions.answer: Open-ended outputs me multiple correct answers ho sakte hain aur surface fluency correctness guarantee nahi karti.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.
